verified_role: Consultant Medical Oncologist. Apollo's official Hyderabad oncologist listing places her at Apollo Hospitals, Financial District / Apollo Health City Jubilee Hills; she also holds a per-doctor profile as a Medical Oncologist at the American Oncology Institute cancer centre at Citizens Specialty Hospital, Nallagandla, Hyderabad.
verified_experience: Published figures differ slightly by source and are recorded verbatim: '8+ years' (Apollo Hospitals listing) and 'over seven years of experience in oncology' (American Oncology Institute profile). Qualifications per Apollo: MBBS, MD (General Medicine), DM Medical Oncology, ECMO, FAGE. AOI records the DM (Medical Oncology) as from Sri Venkateswara Institute of Medical Sciences (SVIMS), Tirupati, 2022.
hni_signals: Practises across TWO major private cancer platforms in Hyderabad - Apollo (Financial District / Jubilee Hills) and the American Oncology Institute cancer centre at Citizens Specialty Hospital, Nallagandla - i.e. more than one practice location. DM Medical Oncology from SVIMS Tirupati, one of India's competitive super-specialty oncology programmes; also holds ECMO and FAGE. FOUR PROFESSIONAL SOCIETY MEMBERSHIPS, two of them international, published verbatim by AOI: American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO), European Society of Medical Oncology (ESMO), Indian Society of Medical and Pediatric Oncology (ISMPO) and Indian Cooperative Oncology Network (ICON). Research-active with published case studies and journal articles, including work on bispecific antibodies and CAR-T therapy in multiple myeloma and on pulmonary tuberculosis in breast cancer patients - CAR-T and bispecifics are the most expensive treatment lines in oncology. Runs clinical trials and personalised/targeted therapy, immunotherapy and multidisciplinary tumour-board care - all premium, high-value oncology service lines. No leadership title (Director/HOD) and no published procedure volume were found, so none is claimed.

notes: IDENTITY: the surname Pericherla is rare and returned exactly one doctor in oncology. Matched on name + specialty (Medical Oncology) + city (Hyderabad) across two independent hospital groups, and the Apollo side additionally matches the source row's employer and 'Oncology' department. BAND HIGH, with the independence reasoning stated explicitly: (1) apollohospitals.com - official, and it names her with her qualifications and 8+ years; (2) americanoncology.com - a different hospital group's own site with a full per-doctor profile. citizenshospitals.com carries a third per-doctor page but is NOT counted as a further independent source, because AOI's Hyderabad cancer centre physically operates inside Citizens Specialty Hospital, Nallagandla - they are one practice location under two brands. Two genuinely independent official sources therefore support this row. NO APOLLO PER-DOCTOR URL: despite a domain-restricted search across apollohospitals.com / apollo247.com / askapollo.com, no doctor-specific Apollo page for her surfaced. Per the golden rules NO Apollo doctor URL was constructed from the known pattern; hospital_profile therefore points at the AOI per-doctor page, which is a genuine official hospital doctor profile, and the Apollo listing pages that DO name her are recorded under other_profiles. appointment_link is left blank because no booking page specific to her was seen. NO EMAIL OR PHONE: none published anywhere in five searches. Two contact-broker style pages (reachstream.com and medicprospects.com 'oncologist email list' pages) appeared in results and were REJECTED outright as scraped databases - nothing was taken from them. Do not substitute the Apollo group lines 04069321004 / 040-2360-7777. LINKEDIN DELIBERATELY BLANK: a LinkedIn profile named 'Sindhu Pericherla' exists but is a quality-assurance professional in the Greater Toronto Area, Canada - a DIFFERENT person - so it was not recorded. A LinkedIn people-directory page listing five same-name profiles also appeared; none could be tied to this doctor. FOR A HUMAN: worth confirming which affiliation is current. The Apollo listing gives 8+ years while AOI gives 'over seven', suggesting AOI/Citizens may be the earlier post and Apollo Financial District the current one, consistent with the source row - but no page states a start or end date, so both are recorded as live routes.
